facts: The earliest recognized qualifying dispatch event depends on order eligibility and shipping method.
Carrier acceptance, USPS manifest, in-app single scan and in-app batch scan may qualify for eligible orders.
In-App Scan and TikTok Manifest do not replace physical handoff or carrier acceptance.
In-App Scan currently excludes Seller Shipping and requires TikTok Shipping labels.
WEM separates label, readiness, platform scan, physical handoff and carrier acceptance as five controls.
